# Excalidraw Element Bounds

This layer calculates and manages the bounds of elements, handles text element rendering and positioning, and manages binding strategies and their properties.

## Overview

This layer is responsible for managing the spatial properties of elements within the Excalidraw application, including their bounds, text rendering, and binding strategies.

## How it works

- `bounds.ts`: Calculates and manages the bounds of elements.
- `textElement.ts`: Handles text element rendering and positioning.
- `binding.ts`: Manages binding strategies and their properties.

## Configuration

- Environment variables: `PROD`, `VITE_APP_DEBUG_ENABLE_TEXT_CONTAINER_BOUNDING_BOX`.
- Configuration files: `packages/element/.eslintrc.json`, `packages/element/tsconfig.json`.
